questions.contextText:
Comprehension Passage – I (Questions 41 – 45): Read the following passage carefully and
answer the questions that follow.
Dark-sky reserves—designated protected areas where artificial light pollution is strictly regulated—
are gaining global prominence as essential sanctuaries for both astronomical observation and
nocturnal ecology. Over the past century, unchecked proliferation of unshielded LED streetlights,
illuminated billboards, and urban skyglow has disrupted the circadian rhythms of countless
nocturnal species, disorienting migratory birds, sea turtle hatchlings, and essential insect
pollinators. Beyond ecological disruption, chronic exposure to artificial light at night suppresses
melatonin production in humans, elevating risks of metabolic and sleep disorders. Establishing
dark-sky reserves involves retrofitting outdoor fixtures with downward-shielded, warm-spectrum
luminaires and adopting adaptive motion-sensor dimming—measures that simultaneously restore
starry nightscapes, conserve municipal electricity, and foster sustainable astrotourism in rural
regions.
questions.questionText: How does artificial light pollution negatively affect nocturnal wildlife according to the passage?
options: It accelerates photosynthesis in deep-ocean kelp forests
It disrupts circadian rhythms and disorients migratory birds, sea turtle hatchlings, and pollinators
It eliminates the need for coastal nesting habitats among marine turtles
It increases nocturnal rainfall over urban metropolitan zones

questions.questionText: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ଚାରୋଟି ବିକଳ୍ପ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ସେହି ବିକଳ୍ପକୁ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ରୂଢ଼ିର ଅର୍ଥକୁ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରେ । ମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ତେନ୍ତୁଳିଆ ବିଛା କାମୁଡ଼ିବା
ଏହି ବସ୍ତୁନିଷ୍ଠ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ଇଂରାଜୀ ବାକ୍ୟଟି ପାଇଁ ସଠିକ୍ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଅନୁବାଦ ବିକଳ୍ପ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ: The central bank raised interest rates to control inflation and maintain price stability in the economy.
options: ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ସେଣ୍ଟର ଦାମ ବଢ଼ାଇ ଦେଶର ମୁଦ୍ରା ବିନିମୟ ସମ୍ବଳିତ କରିଛି ।
ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ନୀତି ପାଇଁ ସେଣ୍ଟର ଦାମ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥିରତା ବଢ଼ାଇ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଛି ।
ମୁଦ୍ରାସ୍ଫୀତି ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ଓ ଦାମ ସ୍ଥିରତା ପାଇଁ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ସୁଧର ହାର ବଢ଼ାଇଲା ।
